summary: StorageDescriptor(ProfileSpec) — frozen dataclass with storage-domain metadata: sdk_package (e.g. 'boto3'), handler_module (dotted path to backend), handler_class, supports_streaming, supports_multipart, read_only. Each provider settings module defines a singleton *_SPEC instance of this class. Renamed from 'descriptor' to 'spec' in mountainash-settings 26.5.0.
extension_points: New providers define a StorageDescriptor instance capturing their SDK, handler, and capability flags
lifecycle_notes: Renamed: formerly 'StorageDescriptor' (descriptor pattern), now aligned with mountainash-settings ProfileSpec naming — the class name itself remains StorageDescriptor but the *_DESCRIPTOR aliases were removed in Phase 4b
documentation_hooks: read_only=True on GitHubRepoSettings drives UnsupportedOperationError on write operations

evidence.detail: Tests that spec fields are consistent across provider specs
